observations.notes: Every required atom present; tradition unknown in the set. The claim boundary is carried: the quotation check kept apart from the interpretive warrant, proposals held apart from seats, the pages ranking nothing, the open items listed. Lineage present as the January primers and the July erratum the deposit answers, with the erratum's cause (the removal of 2026-06-19, #1426) left out. Identifier present as the deposit offered in the answer's table of where to find things; deposit chain present as the commits and SHA-256 carried with their point. Two image cards from outside the archive are set on the worked route; they are the source strip and satisfy nothing.
